name: macro-monitor
description: A local, watch-only macro dashboard inspired by the Wall Street Raider Macro Monitor mod. Pulls ~18 series from FRED (free API), renders a single self-contained `dashboard.html`: regime chip, risk chips, indicator cells with 3m/12m trends, and full-history charts (back to the 1940s-50s for most US series) with US recession shading, hover crosshairs, and 10y/25y/Max ranges.
